name: writing-honest-claims
title_zh: 证据撑不起的词，一个都不写进结论
tagline_zh: 写分析结论总被质疑「你确定吗」？它把每句话按证据强度分三档，因果词自动亮红，让你交出去的报告经得起追问。
tagline_en: Tired of being challenged on every conclusion? It grades each sentence by evidence strength, flags causal words.
desc_en: Writes findings in language the evidence can carry — the claim ladder (observed → directional → decision-support, never causal without a design), effect sizes over drama, banned phrasings. Use when writing any conclusion, report section, playbook, or public page from analysis results.
why_zh: 不是改措辞，是强制你走「观察→方向→决策」三级阶梯，没实验设计就不许说因果，从机制上堵住过度解读。
why_en: Not a thesaurus. It forces a three-rung ladder—observed, directional, decision-support—and refuses causal language absent a.
limit_zh: 只处理从分析结果到书面结论这一步，不碰数据清洗和建模；只认英文输入，中文报告需先自行翻译；不检查统计显著性本身。
limit_en: Only polishes analysis-to-conclusion text, not data prep or modeling. English input only. Doesn't verify statistics, only language-evidence fit.
title_en: A claim ladder that blocks words your evidence can't carry
